titulo: O DONO DO PRÉDIO E O CORAL
personagens: Elisa, a woman around 55 with silver hair in a short bob and a knitted orange shawl; the building owner, a man around 50 with slicked-back hair and a gray suit; a choir of residents of different ages
cenario: an old apartment building community hall with a covered piano and folding chairs
cenas: Elisa holding a letter in an empty community hall where all the choir chairs have disappeared
Elisa looking at the bare floor marks where chairs used to be
The building owner on the phone with renovation plans, Elisa gathering old photographs of the hall
The owner visiting the hall and lifting the cover off an old piano, asking who still plays it
Elisa holding a photo album of decades of choir concerts
Elisa showing the owner a video on a tablet of a choir performance featuring his mother as a young woman
The owner moved, looking at the screen in silence
Residents presenting a shared-use schedule to the owner at a table with blueprints
